svg.title: damian@github ~ neofetch
svg.desc: Damian: Product Developer from Poland. Role: Product Developer. Based: Poland. Ships: web · mobile · desktop. Web: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query. Backend: Node.js, Express, Laravel, Django, Prisma, Supabase. Mobile: Flutter, Dart, BLoC. Desktop: C#, .NET 10, Avalonia. Data: PostgreSQL, SQLite, Oracle. AI: Claude Code, Codex, custom agent skills, Vapi, Twilio. Tooling: Git, Docker, Vitest. Now: shipping Stronger to Google Play. Open to: software developer internship, remote.
